answer: Agents stake hardware-attested identities whose lattice public keys are sealed in side-channel-resistant enclaves, binding each pseudonym to a costly physical anchor as meadow plot or tundra relay. Colluders attempting to flood the economy with shadow identities must replicate scarce enclave attestations, and every duplicate leaves an opal-marked audit trace across. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
